cards.hint: Think about parental contributions to each cell.
options: two alleles, one inherited from each parent
one allele inherited from a single parent
four alleles, two from each parent
three alleles shared across the gene pool
cards.quote: Every diploid cell has two alleles, one inherited from each parent.
cards.stem: What describes allele inheritance in a diploid cell?

cards.hint: Focus on the meaning of different alleles.
cards.quote: If an individual has two different alleles at a specific locus, the individual is heterozygous at that locus
cards.stem: Which term describes a person with different alleles at one locus?

cards.hint: Focus on the meaning of matching alleles.
options: two different alleles at a specific locus
cards.quote: if the two alleles are the same, the individual is homozygous
cards.stem: Which description fits a case where both alleles at a locus match?

cards.hint: Think about all members of a species together.
options: probability of transmitting genes to the next generation
two different alleles at a specific locus
cards.quote: A gene pool is the unique set of alleles that could be found by analyzing the DNA from every member of a species or population.
cards.stem: What does the term gene pool describe?
